title: Delaunay spatial network
intent: Expose local adjacency among real automobile weight and fuel-economy observations by connecting every edge of a Delaunay triangulation.

ai.create: Create a quantitative point diagram from automobile weight and fuel economy that connects all unique Delaunay edges. Plot should use its native delaunayLink mark; TanStack should convert granular d3-delaunay halfedges and hull indexes into typed link endpoints before rendering.
ai.maintain: Change the selected cars while keeping each undirected edge unique, closing the convex hull, preserving the source fields and stable car identity, and avoiding an umbrella D3 import or consumer casts.
